CompletionRequest.description: Optional completion body. Omit it (or `date`) to complete for today.

date.description: Completion date in the app zone; not in the future

completedTodayCount.description: Active habits with a completion today

today.description: Active daily habits plus active weekly habits not done this week (D-24)

byStatus.description: Number of cards per status; every status is present

milestonesCompletedLast7Days.description: Milestones marked done in the last 7 days (D-30)

active.description: IN_PROGRESS plans with progress and remainingSeconds (BR-12)

DashboardResponse.description: Every dashboard widget, computed from live data at serverTime (FR-09, D-50)

greeting.description: "Good morning/afternoon/evening, {displayName}" in the app zone (D-52, A-02)

DashboardTasks.description: Task widgets. Archived tasks are ignored everywhere

completedToday.description: DONE with completedAt today, newest first

completionPercent.description: doneCount ÷ totalActive, rounded, 0–100; 0 when there are no tasks (D-15)

dueToday.description: dueDate = today, any status, by id

HabitResponse.description: A habit with its computed progress fields

currentStreak.description: Consecutive days (daily) or ISO weeks (weekly) completed, ending now or in the previous period

doneThisPeriod.description: Daily: done today. Weekly: at least one completion in the current ISO week

doneToday.description: A completion exists for today (any frequency)

progressPercent.description: Daily: completed days in the last 7 ÷ 7. Weekly: completed weeks in the last 4 ÷ 4. 0–100

LearningCardRequest.description: Create or update a learning card

description.description: Description or source (link, book, course name)

status.description: Manual status override (update only; ignored on create). Omit to keep the current status. A later milestone change re-derives it.

LearningCardResponse.description: A learning card with its milestones, notes and computed progress

progressPercent.description: milestonesDone ÷ milestonesTotal, 0–100; 0 when there are no milestones

status.description: Derived from milestones (D-31) unless set manually since the last milestone change

MilestoneRequest.description: Add or update a milestone of a learning card

done.description: Update only: mark done/not done. Omit to keep. Ignored on create.

targetDate.description: Optional target date; null clears it on update

MilestoneResponse.description: A milestone of a learning card

NoteRequest.description: Add a note to a learning card

NoteResponse.description: A note on a learning card

PlanItemDoneRequest.description: Mark a plan item done or not done

done.description: true = done (applies the BR-13 side effect), false = not done (source is not reverted)

PlanItemRequest.description: A plan item: an existing task, habit or learning card

sourceId.description: Id of the task, habit or learning card

PlanItemResponse.description: A plan item with its source's current title and status (D-48)

sourceStatus.description: TASK: TODO|IN_PROGRESS|DONE. LEARNING_RESOURCE: NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED. HABIT: DONE|PENDING|INACTIVE for the current period (A-08)

sourceTitle.description: Task title, habit name or learning card title

PlanRequest.description: Create or update (full replace) a plan. On update, items whose source is kept keep their done flag.

priorityOrder.description: 1 = highest priority (D-41); need not be unique

PlanResponse.description: A plan with its items and values computed at serverTime (D-43, D-44)

progressPercent.description: doneItems ÷ totalItems, 0–100; 0 when there are no items

remainingSeconds.description: Seconds until endDateTime while IN_PROGRESS, else null (BR-12)

serverTime.description: Server clock when computed; use it to correct client clock skew

startsInSeconds.description: Seconds until startDateTime while NOT_STARTED, else null (A-01)

status.description: Derived: COMPLETED if all items done or now ≥ end; IN_PROGRESS if start ≤ now < end; else NOT_STARTED

detail.example: One or more fields are invalid

errors.description: Field name → message; present on validation and business-rule errors

SettingsRequest.description: Update the settings. Omitted flags or defaultView keep their current value (A-10)

dueDate.description: Optional due date. On update, omitted/null clears it

priority.description: Create: defaults to MEDIUM. Update: omitted keeps the current priority

status.description: Create: defaults to TODO. Update: omitted keeps the current status

TaskResponse.description: A task with its computed overdue flag

overdue.description: dueDate is before today, status is not DONE, and the task is not archived
